headline: Sherritt Posts $55.5M Third-Quarter Loss Following US Cuba Sanctions
summary: Canadian resource company Sherritt International lost US$55.5 million in the third quarter after US sanctions forced the shutdown of its Cuban mining operations, triggering missed debt payments.
why: Sherritt is a Canadian nickel and cobalt producer with long-standing operational joint ventures in Cuba, leaving it exposed to US geopolitical sanctions and embargo enforcement.

impacts.name: Sherritt International
impacts.why: Operations halted by sanctions generated severe quarterly losses and caused the company to miss debt obligations.
